summary: Narrow shaded lane beside bushland; apartments 12-14 m away on the west.

best_section.where: West edge of Bryce Street, midway along, beside the bush on the east

drivers.seclusion: Dense bushland on the east side. Apartments sit 12-14 m away on the west, partly screened by trees.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane; a couple of cars are parked along it, but the verge is thin and trees close in, so room is tight.
drivers.traffic: Low-traffic lane; a busy road at the south end.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along the lane, though 2P resident-permit signs apply Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

flags: Max grade 10.8% at the south end; about 1.5% along best section
Low-lying: minimum elevation 4.9 m, Brisbane River 288 m away
Noise from the busy road at the south end
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the lane, especially from the east; shaded most of the day.
cannot_judge: True lane width between trees and parked cars
